mentions.name: Lekker VPN
mentions.description: Lekker VPN is a South African consumer VPN service built on WireGuard, about six months in development, with surprisingly complex infrastructure under the hood. An Apple App Store release is in progress, with the App Store review process currently the biggest hurdle.
mentions.audience: Consumers in South Africa looking for a VPN service
mentions.source_excerpt:
https://lekkervpn.co.za/

A south african wireguard-based consumer VPN service - surprisingly complex under the hood, about 6 months in the making so far!

Apple app store review is the biggest hurdle currently
